movies.summary: One minute. One mic. No mercy. Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests put up-and-coming comedians to the test at a relentless Austin.
movies.tagline: Yippee.

movies.title: Killer Whale
movies.summary: Follows best friends Maddie and Trish as they find themselves trapped in a remote lagoon with the dangerous killer whale named Ceto.
movies.tagline: It's feeding time.

movies.title: Killers
movies.summary: A vacationing woman meets her ideal man, leading to a swift marriage. Back at home, however, their idyllic life is upset when they discover their neighbors could be assassins who have been contracted to kill the couple.
movies.tagline: Perfect wife. Perfect target.

movies.title: Killing Them Softly
movies.summary: Three amateurs stickup a Mob protected card game, causing the local criminal economy to collapse. Brad Pitt plays the hitman hired to track them down and restore order.
movies.tagline: In America you're on your own.

movies.title: King Arthur: Legend of the Sword
movies.summary: Robbed of his birthright, Arthur comes up the hard way in the back alleys of the city. But once he pulls the sword from the stone, he is forced to acknowledge his true legacy - whether he likes it or not.
movies.tagline: From nothing comes a King

movies.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
movies.summary: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.
movies.tagline: No one can stop the reign.

movies.title: Kiss the Girls
movies.summary: Alex Cross, a Washington D.C. cop and forensic psychologist learns that his niece who is going to college in North Carolina is missing. So he goes there and learns that the police think she's among the victims of someone who kidnaps young girls and holds them captive and kills them who dubs himself Cassanova after the great lover. Later Kate, one of his victims, escapes and tries to help Cross find his niece.
movies.tagline: Smart girls. Pretty girls. Missing girls.

movies.title: Knight and Day
movies.summary: A fugitive couple goes on a glamorous and sometimes deadly adventure where nothing and no one – even themselves – are what they seem. Amid shifting alliances and unexpected betrayals, they race across the globe, with their survival ultimately hinging on the battle of truth vs. trust.
movies.tagline: Every Hit Man Deserves a Second Shot!

movies.title: A Knight's War
movies.summary: A fearless knight braves a deadly realm to save the Chosen One's soul. Facing witches, demons, and brutal foes, he discovers her return could ignite chaos and doom humanity.
movies.tagline: No gods. No mercy.

movies.title: Knights of the Zodiac
movies.summary: When a goddess of war reincarnates in the body of a young girl, street orphan Seiya discovers that he is destined to protect her and save the world. But only if he can face his own past and become a Knight of the Zodiac.
movies.tagline: Go beyond your destiny.

movies.title: Kraken
movies.summary: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?
movies.tagline: Only 5% of the ocean has been explored for a reason…

movies.title: Kraken: Tentacles of the Deep
movies.summary: Thirty years ago, Ray Reiter witnessed the brutal death of his parents at sea by a strange, octopus-like creature. Now determined to exact revenge, he joins archaeologist Nicole on a perilous high-seas expedition to find a legendary Greek Opal - said to be guarded by the very beast that murdered his family. As they come face to face with the killer Kraken, they must also battle a ruthless crime lord, who will stop at nothing to seize the coveted treasure for himself.

movies.title: Kraven the Hunter
movies.summary: Kraven's complex relationship with his ruthless father, Nikolai Kravinoff, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.
movies.tagline: Villains aren't born. They're made.

movies.title: Krull
movies.summary: A prince and a fellowship of companions set out to rescue his bride from a fortress of alien invaders who have arrived on their home planet, Krull.
movies.tagline: A world light-years beyond your imagination.

movies.title: L.A. Confidential
movies.summary: As corruption grows in 1950s Los Angeles, three policemen - one strait-laced, one brutal, and one sleazy - investigate a series of murders with their own brand of justice.
movies.tagline: Everything is suspect... Everyone is for sale... And nothing is what it seems.

movies.title: L'ultimo Dominatore Dell'aria the Last Airbender
Ladies & Gentlemen... 50 Years of SNL Music
movies.summary: A special documentary featuring untold stories behind the culture-defining and groundbreaking musical performances, sketches, and cameos from 50 years of Saturday Night Live, as well as interviews with musical artists, cast, writers and others.
movies.tagline: Ladies & Gentlemen... 50 Years of SNL Music

movies.title: Lainey Wilson: Keepin' Country Cool
movies.summary: Follows country music superstar Lainey Wilson as she redefines what it means to be a modern country star, exploring her personal journey and struggles while captivating fans on stage across the country.

movies.title: The Last Assassins
movies.summary: In a frozen world cloaked in lethal fog, a protector escorts an orphaned girl to her last living relative. Their journey leads to a derelict lab where holographic secrets reveal her family's past and hint at her unique power.

movies.title: Last Breath
movies.summary: A heart-pounding film that follows seasoned deep-sea divers as they battle the raging elements to rescue their crewmate trapped hundreds of feet below the ocean's surface. Based on a true story, LAST BREATH is an electrifying story about teamwork, resilience, and a race against time to do the impossible.
movies.tagline: Make every breath count.

movies.title: The Last Legion
movies.summary: As the Roman empire crumbles, young Romulus Augustus flees the city and embarks on a perilous voyage to Britain to track down a legion of supporters.
movies.tagline: The end of an empire...the beginning of a legend.

movies.title: The Last Rodeo
movies.summary: A retired rodeo legend risks it all to save his grandson. Facing his own painful past and the fears of his family, he enters a high-stakes bullriding competition as the oldest contestant ever. Along the way, he reconciles old wounds with his estranged daughter and proves that true courage is found in the fight for family.
movies.tagline: Family is forever

movies.title: The Last Stand of Ellen Cole
movies.summary: When an evil contractor goes to extreme measures to evict a testy tenant who is standing in the way of his new project, he fails to take into account that this seemingly harmless old woman is a trained killer and will do anything to protect her beloved home.

movies.title: The Last Sunrise
movies.summary: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.
movies.tagline: One summer to feel everything.

movies.title: The Last Supper
movies.summary: In the days leading up to his death, Jesus gathers his disciples for the Last Supper. Amidst words of love and farewell, while faith is strengthened, the shadow of betrayal hangs over, but not even pain can erase the promise of redemption.
movies.tagline: All are welcome at the table.

movies.title: The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen
movies.summary: Renowned adventurer Allan Quatermain leads a team of extraordinary figures with legendary powers to battle the technological terror of a madman known as "The Fantom". This "League" comprises seafarer and inventor Captain Nemo, vampire Mina Harker, an invisible man named Rodney Skinner, American Secret Service Agent Tom Sawyer, the ageless and invincible Dorian Gray, and the dangerous split personality of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.
movies.tagline: The power of seven become a league of one.

movies.title: Leatherheads
movies.summary: A light hearted comedy about the beginnings of Professional American Football. When a decorated war hero and college all star is tempted into playing professional football. Everyone see the chance to make some big money, but when a reporter digs up some dirt on the war hero... everyone could lose out.
movies.tagline: If Love Is a Game, Who'll Make the First Pass?

movies.title: Lee Cronin's The Mummy
movies.summary: Eight years after her sudden disappearance in Egypt, a severely traumatized teenager is returned to her shattered family in New Mexico, triggering a visceral nightmare as they realize she is hosting an ancient, demonic parasite.
movies.tagline: What happened to Katie?

movies.title: A Legend
movies.summary: An archeologist noticed that the texture of the relics discovered during the excavation of a glacier closely resembled a jade pendant seen in one of his dreams. He and his team then embark on an expedition into the depths of the glacier.
movies.tagline: When past and present collide, only a legend remains.

movies.title: Léon: The Professional
movies.summary: After her father, step-mother, step-sister and little brother are killed by her father's employers, the 12-year-old daughter of an abject drug dealer manages to take refuge in the apartment of a professional hitman who at her request teaches her the methods of his job so she can take her revenge on the corrupt DEA agent who ruined her life by killing her beloved brother.
movies.tagline: If you want the job done right, hire a professional.

movies.title: Letters to Juliet
movies.summary: Sophie travels to Verona where she finds an old unanswered letter asking for love advice. She answers it and when the recipient shows up along with her grumpy grandson, they head off to find the old long lost love while a young love sparks
movies.tagline: What if you had a second chance to find true love?

movies.title: Life
movies.summary: Life tells the story of the six-member crew of the International Space Station that is on the cutting edge of one of the most important discoveries in human history: the first evidence of extraterrestrial life on Mars. As the crew begins to conduct research, their methods end up having unintended consequences and the life form proves more intelligent than anyone ever expected.
movies.tagline: Be careful what you search for.

movies.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
movies.summary: With a plan to exact revenge on a legendary shark that killed his partner, oceanographer Steve Zissou rallies a crew that includes his estranged wife, a journalist, and a man who may or may not be his son.
movies.tagline: The deeper you go, the weirder life gets.

movies.title: Lilo & Stitch
movies.summary: A lonely Hawaiian girl befriends a runaway alien, helping to mend her fragmented family.
movies.tagline: Hold on to your coconuts.

movies.title: Limitless
movies.summary: The life of an unsuccessful writer is transformed by a top-secret 'smart drug' that allows him to use 100% of his brain and become a perfect version of himself. His enhanced abilities soon attract shadowy forces that threaten his new life.
movies.tagline: What if a pill could make you rich and powerful?

movies.title: Lincoln
movies.summary: The revealing story of the 16th US President's tumultuous final months in office. In a nation divided by war and the strong winds of change, Lincoln pursues a course of action designed to end the war, unite the country and abolish slavery. With the moral courage and fierce determination to succeed, his choices during this critical moment will change the fate of generations to come.
movies.tagline: The hours that changed history.

movies.title: The Lincoln Lawyer
movies.summary: Mick Haller is a defense lawyer who works out of his Lincoln. When a wealthy Realtor's son is accused of assaulting a prostitute, Haller is asked to defend him. The man claims that the woman is trying to get some money out of him. But when Haller looks at the evidence against him, he learns that this case might be linked to an old case of his.
movies.tagline: This case is a dangerous game of life and death.

movies.title: A Line of Fire
movies.summary: After working as a secret agent in the FBI for ten years, Jack 'Cash' Conry left it all behind after his wife passed in order to dedicate himself to his two daughters. Despite a fulfilling life at home, Cash misses the chance to make an impact and has been considering a return to the force. The decision is made for him when his old partner’s niece Jamie calls him for help, launching Cash right back into a world of danger, corruption and intrigue.
movies.tagline: He left the game. The danger found him anyway.

movies.title: Little Shop of Horrors
movies.summary: Seymour Krelborn is a nerdy orphan working at Mushnik's, a flower shop in urban Skid Row. He harbors a crush on fellow co-worker, Audrey Fulquard, and is berated by Mr. Mushnik daily. One day, Seymour finds a very mysterious unidentified plant which he calls Audrey II. The plant seems to have a craving for blood and soon begins to sing for its supper.
movies.tagline: A singing plant. A daring hero. A sweet girl. A demented dentist. It's the most outrageous musical comedy in years.

movies.title: The Loft
movies.summary: Five married men secretly share a penthouse loft in the city where they can carry out secret affairs. However, their fantasy becomes a nightmare when they discover a dead woman in the loft and realize one of the group must be involved.
movies.tagline: The right place to do wrong.

movies.title: Lolita
movies.summary: Humbert Humbert is a middle-aged British novelist who is both appalled by and attracted to the vulgarity of American culture. When he comes to stay at the boarding house run by Charlotte Haze, he soon becomes obsessed with Lolita, the woman's teenaged daughter.
movies.tagline: A forbidden love. An unthinkable attraction. The ultimate price.

movies.title: The Lone Ranger
movies.summary: The Texas Rangers chase down a gang of outlaws led by Butch Cavendish, but the gang ambushes the Rangers, seemingly killing them all. One survivor is found, however, by an American Indian named Tonto, who nurses him back to health. The Ranger, donning a mask and riding a white stallion named Silver, teams up with Tonto to bring the unscrupulous gang and others of that ilk to justice.
movies.tagline: Never take off the mask.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.summary: Young hobbit Frodo Baggins, after inheriting a mysterious ring from his uncle Bilbo, must leave his home in order to keep it from falling into the hands of its evil creator. Along the way, a fellowship is formed to protect the ringbearer and make sure that the ring arrives at its final destination: Mt. Doom, the only place where it can be destroyed.
movies.tagline: One ring to rule them all.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movies.summary: Gandalf and Aragorn lead the World of Men against Sauron's army to draw his gaze from Frodo and Sam as they approach Mount Doom with the One Ring.
movies.tagline: The journey ends.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
movies.summary: In the second part of the Tolkien trilogy, Frodo Baggins and the other members of the Fellowship continue on their sacred quest to destroy the One Ring--but on separate paths. Their destinies lie at two towers--Orthanc Tower in Isengard, where the corrupt wizard Saruman awaits, and Sauron's fortress at Barad-dur, deep within the dark lands of Mordor.
movies.tagline: The journey continues.

movies.title: The Lost Bus
movies.summary: During the 2018 Camp Fire in Paradise California, the deadliest wildfire in the state's history, 22 elementary school kids are stranded at their school as their families are unable to get them before the fires spread. Now one school bus driver must attempt to drive the kids and a teacher to safety as the wildfire rages around them. Loosely based on a true story.
movies.tagline: Inspired by a true story of survival.

movies.title: The Lost Future
movies.summary: A group of post-apocalyptic survivors struggle to survive in a world where jungles, forests, primeval wetlands and deserts have obliterated civilization. They staunchly face genetically mutated beasts and mysterious diseases in an attempt to re-establish the human race as masters of Earth.
movies.tagline: Welcome to the apocalypse.

movies.title: Lost in Translation
movies.summary: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.
movies.tagline: Everyone wants to be found.

movies.title: Love & Other Drugs
movies.summary: Maggie (Hathaway) is an alluring free spirit who won't let anyone - or anything - tie her down. But she meets her match in Jamie (Gyllenhaal), whose relentless and nearly infallible charm serve him well with the ladies and in the cutthroat world of pharmaceutical sales. Maggie and Jamie's evolving relationship takes them both by surprise, as they find themselves under the influence of the ultimate drug: love.
movies.tagline: Addicted to one-night stands or dependent on one another?

movies.title: Love at Second Sight
movies.summary: A man tries to make his wife fall in love with him again, after waking up in an alternate reality where she never knew him.

movies.title: Love Potion No. 9
movies.summary: Unlucky in love, chemist Paul Matthews visits gypsy Madame Rosa for help. Quickly realizing he is a hopeless nerd, she gifts him with Love Potion No. 8, which makes anyone who wears it irresistible to the opposite sex for four hours. Paul and animal psychologist coworker Diane Farrow decide to test it on themselves. The awkward pair suddenly find themselves alluring to anyone they approach, but soon realize they are most attracted to each other.
movies.tagline: Imagine if sex appeal came in a bottle.

movies.title: The Lovely Bones
movies.summary: A fourteen-year-old girl in suburban 1970's Pennsylvania is murdered by her neighbor. She tells the story from the place between Heaven and Earth, showing the lives of the people around her and how they have changed all while attempting to get someone to find her lost body.
movies.tagline: The story of a life and everything that came after...

movies.title: The Lucky One
movies.summary: A Marine travels to Louisiana after serving three tours in Iraq and searches for the unknown woman he believes was his good luck charm during the war.
movies.tagline: From the acclaimed bestselling author of The Notebook and Dear John

movies.title: Lucky Strike
movies.summary: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.
movies.tagline: One man's fight to survive.

movies.title: M3GAN 2.0
movies.summary: Two years after M3GAN's rampage, her creator, Gemma, resorts to resurrecting her infamous creation in order to take down Amelia, the military-grade weapon who was built by a defense contractor who stole M3GAN's underlying tech.
movies.tagline: Miss me?

movies.title: Maa
movies.summary: A mother transforms into the goddess Kali to battle a demon's curse involving fear, blood, and betrayal.
movies.tagline: Hell is here, so is the goddess.

movies.title: Madea's Destination Wedding
movies.summary: Madea and her family travel to Tiffany's rushed destination wedding in the Bahamas, where tensions arise as Tiffany doubts her fiancé Zavier, and her mother acts strangely, raising suspicions about the marriage's legitimacy.
movies.tagline: They trippin'.

movies.title: Magic Beyond Words the J K Rowling Story
movies.summary: An inspiring look at JK Rowling's rise to become one of the most influential writers-from her humble beginnings as an imaginative young girl and awkward teenager to the loss of her mother and the genesis of the Harry Potter phenomenon.

movies.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
movies.summary: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

movies.title: Man of Steel
movies.summary: A young boy learns that he has extraordinary powers and is not of this Earth. As a young man, he journeys to discover where he came from and what he was sent here to do. But the hero in him must now emerge if he is to save the world from annihilation and become the symbol of hope for all mankind.
movies.tagline: You are not alone.

movies.title: The Map That Leads to You
movies.summary: Heather is a young woman traveling Europe with friends before starting her perfectly planned life. A chance meeting with Jack sparks an unexpected romance that leads to deep emotional discovery. As secrets and life choices test their bond, her path changes forever.
movies.tagline: Love is a journey worth taking.

movies.title: Marie Antoinette
movies.summary: The retelling of France's iconic but ill-fated queen, Marie Antoinette. From her betrothal and marriage to Louis XVI at 14 to her reign as queen at 19 and to the end of her reign as queen, and ultimately the fall of Versailles.
movies.tagline: Rumor. Scandal. Sex. Fame. Revolution.

movies.title: Mars Attacks!
movies.summary: It is a normal day for everyone, until President of the United States James Dale (Jack Nicholson) announces Martians have been spotted circling Earth. The Martians land and a meeting is arranged, but not everything goes to plan, and the Martians seem to have other plans for Earth. Are they just misunderstood beings or do they really want to destroy all of humanity?
movies.tagline: Nice planet. We'll take it!

movies.title: Marty Supreme
movies.summary: Marty Mauser (Timothée Chalamet), a wily hustler with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness in this globe-spanning, full-throttle thrill ride from Josh Safdie (Uncut Gems).
movies.tagline: Dream big.

movies.title: Marty, Life Is Short
movies.summary: The definitive documentary on comedian Martin Short, exploring his career across film, television, theater and comedy.

movies.title: The Marvels
movies.summary: When her duties send her to an anomalous wormhole linked to a Kree revolutionary, Carol's powers become entangled with that of Jersey City super-fan Kamala Khan, aka Ms. Marvel, and Carol's estranged niece, now S.A.B.E.R. astronaut Captain Monica Rambeau. Together, this unlikely trio must team up and learn to work in concert to save the universe.
movies.tagline: Higher. Further. Faster. Together.

movies.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
movies.summary: Victor Frankenstein is a promising young doctor who, devastated by the death of his mother during childbirth, becomes obsessed with bringing the dead back to life. His experiments lead to the creation of a monster, which Frankenstein has put together with the remains of corpses. It's not long before Frankenstein regrets his actions.
movies.tagline: Be warned.

movies.title: The Mask
movies.summary: Timid bank clerk, Stanley Ipkiss (Jim Carrey). Unfortunately, he's too gentle, and is unable to handle confrontations. After one of the worst days, he finds a mask which depicts Loki, the Norse god of mischief. When he puts it on, he becomes his inner, self: a cartoon wild man. After Ipkiss's alter ego indirectly kills the friend of small time crime boss, Dorian Tyrel (Peter Greene),he wants the green-faced goon destroyed.
movies.tagline: From zero to hero.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.summary: When He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) is driven from Eternia after Skeletor (Frank Langella) seizes Castle Grayskull, a stolen portal device strands the fight on Earth, where a pair of teenagers become entangled in a war that spans worlds.
movies.tagline: A battle fought in the stars...now comes to Earth.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.summary: Prince Adam discovers that the strange memories shaping his life are real when the lost Sword of Power resurfaces, forcing him to return to Eternia and challenge the tyrant who shattered his family and kingdom.
movies.tagline: Legends aren't born, they're forged.

movies.title: Max Payne
movies.summary: Coming together to solve a series of murders in New York City are a police detective and an assassin, who will be hunted by the police, the mob, and a ruthless corporation.
movies.tagline: When a man has lost everything, he only has revenge.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.summary: Lieutenant Troy Kelly takes part in a top secret surveillance mission over Soviet airspace. Things take a sharp turn, however, when he is forced to eject from his plane over the Russian wilderness. He is rescued by a paradoxical Russian native and the two begin to appreciate both their differences and commonalities.
movies.tagline: A friendship with major red flags.

movies.title: Mayhem Requiem Apple Music Special
movies.summary: The opera house for Lady Gaga's MAYHEM Ball tour has been reduced to rubble, and now it's time for MAYHEM Requiem, a musical celebration and reinterpretation of her seventh studio album.
movies.tagline: “Stranger, Remember Me”

movies.title: Mean Girls
movies.summary: Cady Heron is a hit with the Plastics, an A-list girl clique at her new school. But everything changes when she makes the mistake of falling for Aaron Samuels, the ex-boyfriend of alpha Plastic Regina George.
movies.tagline: Plastic is forever.

movies.title: The Mechanic
movies.summary: An elite hitman teaches his trade to an apprentice who has a connection to one of his previous victims.
movies.tagline: Someone has to fix the problems.

movies.title: Medieval
movies.summary: The story of fifteenth century Czech icon and warlord, Jan Zizka, who defeated armies of the Teutonic Order and the Holy Roman Empire.
movies.tagline: For honor. For justice. For freedom.

movies.title: Melania
movies.summary: An intimate chronicle offers a rare glimpse into the life of Melania Trump, exploring her role as First Lady and her relationship with the President.
movies.tagline: Twenty days to history.

movies.title: Memento
movies.summary: Memento chronicles two separate stories of Leonard, an ex-insurance investigator who can no longer build new memories, as he attempts to find the murderer of his wife, which is the last thing he remembers. One story line moves forward in time while the other tells the story backwards revealing more each time.
movies.tagline: Some memories are best forgotten.

movies.title: Mercy
movies.summary: Set in the near future, a detective accused of murdering his wife has 90 minutes to prove his innocence to an advanced AI judge.
movies.tagline: Prove your innocence to an AI judge or face execution.

movies.title: Mickey 17
movies.summary: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.
movies.tagline: He's dying to save mankind.

movies.title: Mighty Joe Young
movies.summary: A legendary fifteen-foot tall mountain gorilla named Joe is taken to an animal sanctuary in California by zoologist Gregg O'Hara (Bill Paxton) and Jill Young (Charlize Theron), with whom he grew up. Poacher Strasser (Rade Serbedzija) returns from the past to seek vengeance on Joe.
movies.tagline: Survival is an instinct.

movies.title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
movies.summary: Two friends navigate the dangerous world of organized crime, testing their loyalty and survival skills as they get deeper into the criminal underworld.
movies.tagline: A time-traveling, double-crossing, ass-kicking comedy.

movies.title: The Million Dollar Hotel
movies.summary: Tragi-comic, romantic whodunnit set in a run down hotel which plays host to mentally ill people too poor to afford medical insurance.
movies.tagline: Everyone has something to hide.

movies.title: A Minecraft Movie
movies.summary: Four misfits are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into a bizarre cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home they'll have to master this world while embarking on a quest with an unexpected expert crafter.
movies.tagline: Be there and be square.

movies.title: Miracle Beach
movies.summary: A romantically hapless young man (Scott) has his life changed when he finds the proverbial genie-in-a-bottle, in this case a very comely lass (Jeannie). With Jeannie granting wishes left and right, Scott soon has a fine house, a wonderful car, and a chance to impress the girl of his dreams. But is this the way to true happiness?
movies.tagline: It will really raise your spirits.

movies.title: Miracle: The Boys of '80
movies.summary: This is the story of the “Miracle on Ice,” when the 1980 US Hockey Team beat the USSR in the Olympic semi-finals at the height of the Cold War to bring home a gold medal. Their iconic underdog story is told with never-before-seen 16mm footage and firsthand reflections from the players who were brought back to the scene of their historic victory.

movies.title: The Misfits
movies.summary: After being recruited by a group of unconventional thieves, renowned criminal Richard Pace finds himself caught up in an elaborate gold heist that promises to have far-reaching implications on his life and the lives of countless others.
movies.tagline: They're not bad guys. They just steal from them.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
movies.summary: When an IMF mission ends badly, the world is faced with dire consequences. As Ethan Hunt takes it upon himself to fulfill his original briefing, the CIA begin to question his loyalty and his motives. The IMF team find themselves in a race against time, hunted by assassins while trying to prevent a global catastrophe.
movies.tagline: Some missions are not a choice.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible - The Final Reckoning
movies.summary: Hunt and the IMF pursue a dangerous AI called the Entity that's infiltrated global intelligence. With governments and a figure from his past in pursuit, Hunt races to stop it from forever changing the world.
movies.tagline: Our lives are the sum of our choices.

movies.title: Mississippi Burning
movies.summary: Two FBI agents investigating the murder of civil rights workers during the 60s seek to breach the conspiracy of silence in a small Southern town where segregation divides black and white. The younger agent trained in FBI school runs up against the small town ways of his former Sheriff partner.
movies.tagline: 1964. When America was at war with itself.

movies.title: Money Talks
movies.summary: Chris Tucker is a small time con man who instantly becomes famous after a murder, wanted dead or alive, his only hope is a journalist named James Russell (Sheen).
movies.tagline: This ain't no buddy movie.

movies.title: Moon
movies.summary: Astronaut Sam Bell has a personal encounter toward the end of his three-year stint on the Moon, where he, working alongside his computer, GERTY, sends home a resource that has helped diminish Earth's power problems.
movies.tagline: 250,000 miles from home, the hardest thing to face... is yourself.

movies.title: Morning Glory
movies.summary: A young and devoted morning television producer is hired as an executive producer on a  long-running morning show at a once-prominent but currently failing station in New York City. Eager to keep the show on air, she recruits a former news journalist and anchor who disapproves of co-hosting a show that does not deal with real news stories.
movies.tagline: What's the story?

movies.title: Mortal Engines
movies.summary: A mysterious young woman, Hester Shaw, emerges as the only one who can stop a giant, predator city on wheels devouring everything in its path. Feral, and fiercely driven by the memory of her mother, Hester joins forces with Tom Natsworthy, an outcast from London, along with Anna Fang, a dangerous outlaw with a bounty on her head.
movies.tagline: Some scars never heal

movies.title: The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones
movies.summary: When her mother disappears, Clary Fray learns that she descends from a line of warriors who protect our world from demons. She joins forces with others like her and heads into a dangerous alternate New York called the Shadow World.
movies.tagline: There is a world hidden within our own.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat II
movies.summary: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.
movies.tagline: Their fight. Our future.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Scorpion's Revenge
movies.summary: Hanzo Hasashi loses his family during an attack by a rival clan the Lin Kuei. He is given the chance to compete in an inter-dimensional tournament to save his loved ones while other fighters try to save the Earth realm from annihilation.
movies.tagline: Extreme violence. Bad language. And a bloody good time.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat: Annihilation
movies.summary: A group of heroic warriors has only six days to save the planet in "Mortal Kombat Annihilation." To succeed they must survive the most spectacular series of challenges any human, or god, has ever encountered as they battle an evil warlord bent on taking control of Earth.
movies.tagline: Destroy all expectations.

movies.title: The Mother
movies.summary: A female assassin/operative in the US Army must reluctantly hand over her teenage daughter Zoe to foster parents for safety because of her risky, uncertain duties. Later, certain situations develop in which Zoe is in danger from assassins. The mother takes charge of her daughter and teaches her survival skills while doing everything possible to safeguard her from harm.
movies.tagline: Vengeance is a mother!

movies.title: Mr. Right
movies.summary: After going through a painful break-up, a woman meets a man who appears to be perfect for her. However, as their relationship develops, she learns that he is a former hit-man. Their new, but genuine, relationship is tested even further as they try to save each other, from his dark past which has come back to haunt him.
movies.tagline: They make a killer couple.

movies.title: Mufasa: The Lion King
movies.summary: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline. The chance meeting sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny.
movies.tagline: The story of an orphan who would be king.

movies.title: The Muppet Show
movies.summary: Kermit and friends return in a modern take on their classic variety show format, mixing nostalgic charm with new comedy bits while staying true to the Muppets' timeless spirit.
movies.tagline: It's time to raise the curtain.

movies.title: Murder at the Embassy
movies.summary: 1934. A private detective, Miranda Green investigates a murder perpetrated in the British Embassy in Cairo, where a top secret document was stolen, risking to jeopardize both Buckingham Palace and the peace of the world.

movies.title: Murder by Numbers
movies.summary: Tenacious homicide detective Cassie Mayweather and her still-green partner are working a murder case, attempting to profile two malevolently brilliant young men: cold, calculating killers whose dark secrets might explain their crimes.
movies.tagline: The only flaw in their plan was her.

movies.title: Music and Lyrics
movies.summary: A washed up singer is given a couple days to compose a chart-topping hit for an aspiring teen sensation. Though he's never written a decent lyric in his life, he sparks with an offbeat younger woman with a flair for words.
movies.tagline: Share the music with someone you love.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.summary: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.
movies.tagline: There's blood in the water.

movies.title: My Best Friend's Girl
movies.summary: Tank faces the ultimate test of friendship when his best friend hires him to take his ex-girlfriend out on a lousy date in order to make her realize how great her former boyfriend is.
movies.tagline: It's funny what love can make you do...

movies.title: My Boss's Daughter
movies.summary: When a young man agrees to housesit for his boss, he thinks it'll be the perfect opportunity to get close to the woman he desperately has a crush on - his boss's daughter. But he doesn't plan on the long line of other houseguests that try to keep him from his mission. And he also has to deal with the daughter's older brother, who's on the run from local drug dealers.
movies.tagline: There are some things you just don't do.

movies.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
movies.summary: Henry Durand is a young federal agent who is given a difficult assignment: spy on his mother and her boyfriend who is suspected of leading a gang of art thieves.
movies.tagline: His mom is dating his suspect. Let the surveillance begin.

movies.title: My Octopus Teacher
movies.summary: After years of swimming every day in the freezing ocean at the tip of Africa, Craig Foster meets an unlikely teacher a young octopus who displays remarkable curiosity. Visiting her den and tracking her movements for months on end he eventually wins the animal's trust and they develop a never before seen bond between human and wild animal.

movies.title: My Old Ass
movies.summary: A mushroom trip brings free-spirited Elliott face-to-face with her 39-year-old self. But when Elliott's "old ass" delivers warnings to her younger self, Elliott realizes she has to rethink everything about her family, life and love.
movies.tagline: What would you ask your older self?

movies.title: My Stepmother Is an Alien
movies.summary: An alien is sent on a secret mission to Earth, where she appears as a gorgeous, attractive, and single lady. Her mission is to make contact with a rather nerdy young scientist, who's quite overwhelmed by her attentions, and isn't aware of the connection between her arrival and his work.
movies.tagline: She's gorgeous, and she's never been kissed. Needless to say, she's from another planet.

movies.title: Mystic River
movies.summary: The tragic murder of a 19-year-old girl reunites three childhood friends still living in Boston--the victim's gangster father, a detective, and the disturbed man they both suspect of killing her.
movies.tagline: We bury our sins, we wash them clean.

movies.title: The Naked Gun
movies.summary: Only one man has the particular set of skills... to lead Police Squad and save the world: Lt. Frank Drebin Jr. Following in his father's footsteps, he must solve a murder case to prevent Police Squad from closure.
movies.tagline: The law's reach never stretched this far.

movies.title: Nate Jackson: Super Funny
movies.summary: Comedian Nate Jackson delivers a mix of scripted jokes and audience interactions, riffing on everything from controversial snack foods to life's daily peculiarities.
movies.tagline: One mic, endless laughs, and a whole lot of truth.

movies.title: The New Mutants
movies.summary: Five young mutants, just discovering their abilities while held in a secret facility against their will, fight to escape their past sins and save themselves.
movies.tagline: There is something new to fear.

movies.title: Next
movies.summary: A Las Vegas magician who can see into the future is pursued by FBI agents seeking to use his abilities to prevent a nuclear terrorist attack.
movies.tagline: If you can see the future, you can save it.

movies.title: Night Hunter
movies.summary: A detective investigates a young woman's apparent escape from captivity. As missing person cases connect to a hidden network of abducted girls, a suspect is caught, yet doubts emerge about whether the real predator still remains unseen.
movies.tagline: When the predator becomes the prey.

movies.title: Nightmare Alley
movies.summary: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.
movies.tagline: Man or beast.

movies.title: Nikki Glaser: Good Girl
movies.summary: Considered one of the most fearless voices in modern comedy, Nikki Glaser delivers a brutally honest special that takes on aging, beauty, and fame - confronting what it means to stay relevant, desirable, and real in a culture that never looks away.

movies.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.summary: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide.
movies.tagline: There are no clean getaways.

movies.title: No Reservations
movies.summary: A master chef, Kate, lives her life like she runs the kitchen at upscale 22 Bleecker Restaurant in Manhattan--with a no-nonsense intensity that both captivates and intimidates everyone around her. With breathtaking precision, she powers through each hectic shift, coordinating hundreds of meals, preparing delicate sauces, seasoning and simmering each dish to absolute perfection.
movies.tagline: Life isn't always made to order.

movies.title: No Strings Attached
movies.summary: Emma is a busy doctor who sets up a seemingly perfect arrangement when she offers her best friend Adam a relationship with one rule: No strings attached. But when a fling becomes a thing, can sex friends stay best friends?
movies.tagline: Friendship has its benefits.

movies.title: Nobody
movies.summary: Hutch Mansell, a suburban dad, overlooked husband, nothing neighbor — a "nobody." When two thieves break into his home one night, Hutch's unknown long-simmering rage is ignited and propels him on a brutal path that will uncover dark secrets he fought to leave behind.
movies.tagline: Never underestimate a nobody.

movies.title: Nobody 2
movies.summary: Workaholic assassin Hutch Mansell takes his family on a much-needed vacation to the small tourist town of Plummerville. However, he soon finds himself in the crosshairs of a corrupt theme-park operator, a shady sheriff, and a bloodthirsty crime boss.
movies.tagline: Nobody ruins his vacation.

movies.title: Nonnas
movies.summary: After losing his beloved mother, a man risks everything to honor her by opening an Italian restaurant with actual grandmothers as the chefs.
movies.tagline: Your table is waiting.

movies.title: The Northman
movies.summary: Prince Amleth is on the verge of becoming a man when his father is brutally murdered by his uncle, who kidnaps the boy's mother. Two decades later, Amleth is now a Viking who's on a mission to save his mother, kill his uncle and avenge his father.
movies.tagline: Conquer your fate.

movies.title: The Notebook
movies.summary: An epic love story centered around an older man who reads aloud to a woman with Alzheimer's. From a faded notebook, the old man's words bring to life the story about a couple who is separated by World War II, and is then passionately reunited, seven years later, after they have taken different paths.
movies.tagline: Behind every great love is a great story.

movies.title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
movies.summary: The original Four Horsemen reunite with a new generation of illusionists to take on powerful diamond heiress Veronika Vanderberg, who leads a criminal empire built on money laundering and trafficking. The new and old magicians must overcome their differences to work together on their most ambitious heist yet.
movies.tagline: Unlock the illusion.

movies.title: Oblivion
movies.summary: One of the few remaining drone repairmen assigned to Earth, its surface devastated after decades of war with the alien Scavs, discovers a crashed spacecraft with contents that bring into question everything he believed about the war, and may even put the fate of mankind in his hands.
movies.tagline: Earth is a memory worth fighting for.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.summary: As a boy becomes more obsessed with basketball he becomes increasingly more angry.

movies.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
movies.summary: Attenborough explores the planet's undersea habitats, revealing the greatest age of ocean discovery and emphasizing the ocean's vital importance while exposing its problems and highlighting opportunities for marine life recovery.
movies.tagline: If we save the sea, we save our world.
movies.director: Colin Butfield, Toby Nowlan, Keith Scholey

movies.title: The Odd Life of Timothy Green
movies.summary: A childless couple bury a box in their backyard, containing all of their wishes for an infant. Soon, a child is born, though Timothy Green is not all that he appears.
movies.tagline: He's a force of nature.

movies.title: Odd Thomas
movies.summary: In a California desert town, a short-order cook with clairvoyant abilities encounters a mysterious man with a link to dark, threatening forces.
movies.tagline: I might see dead people... But then, by God, I do something about it.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.summary: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
movies.tagline: Defy the gods.

movies.title: Off the Grid
movies.summary: After a morally-bankrupt company tries to weaponize a brilliant scientist's revolutionary technology, he goes off the grid to safeguard humanity. When the company sends a strike force to find him, they make their biggest mistake of all – they weaponize the man they are trying to catch.
movies.tagline: You can hide... or fight back.

movies.title: Office Romance
movies.summary: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees, which is severely tested when a sexy new lawyer begins working for her.
movies.tagline: It's going down.

movies.title: Oh, Hi!
movies.summary: Iris and Isaac's first weekend away as a couple is going so well — until Isaac mentions he didn’t know they were a couple. Convinced she's met her perfect guy and that he's just confused, Iris goes to increasingly ridiculous and irrational lengths to prove to Isaac that they are meant to be together.
movies.tagline: When you find the one, lock them down.

movies.title: Oh. What. Fun.
movies.summary: Claire Clauster is the glue that holds her chaotic, lovable family together at the holidays. But this year, after planning a special outing for them, they make a crucial mistake and leave her home alone. Fed up and feeling under appreciated, she sets off on an impromptu adventure of her own. As her family scrambles to find her, Claire discovers the unexpected magic of a Christmas gone off-script.
movies.tagline: Come for the presents. Stay for the baggage.

movies.title: The Old Guard 2
movies.summary: Andy and her team of immortal warriors continue their mission to protect humanity. This time, they have to face off against a formidable new foe who threatens the very fabric of the Old Guard, while also dealing with the return of an immortal who was thought to be long lost.
movies.tagline: Eternity has a price.

movies.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
movies.summary: After a small-town pilot mysteriously dies during flight, passenger Doug White is forced to land the plane to safety and save his entire family on board. Based on an astonishing true story of faith and survival, follows one man's harrowing journey to save his family from insurmountable danger.
movies.tagline: Based on the incredible true story.

movies.title: One Battle After Another
movies.summary: Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving off-grid with his spirited, self-reliant daughter, Willa. When his evil nemesis resurfaces after 16 years and she goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her, father and daughter both battling the consequences of his past.
movies.tagline: Some search for battle, others are born into it...

movies.title: One Day
movies.summary: After spending the night together on the eve of their college graduation, Dexter and Emma are shown each year on the same date to see where they are in their lives. They are sometimes together, and sometimes not.
movies.tagline: Twenty years. Two people.

movies.title: One Mile: Chapter Two
movies.summary: A former special forces operative is forced back onto a remote island when a violent, secretive community takes revenge by abducting his daughter, launching a relentless hunt against enemies prepared for his every move.

movies.title: One More Shot
movies.summary: New Year's Eve 1999. Minnie discovers a bottle of Time Traveling Tequila. Each shot takes her back to the start of the night, giving her a bottle's worth of shots to change the course of her millennium.
movies.tagline: Party like it's 1999.

movies.title: One Shot with Ed Sheeran
movies.summary: Ed Sheeran performs his hits in one continuous take while walking NYC streets, riding subways and meeting fans, creating spontaneous musical moments throughout the city.
movies.tagline: One hour in New York. One continuous shot. No redos.

movies.title: Orangutan
movies.summary: Narrated by Josh Gad, journey high into the rainforest canopy of Southeast Asia where a magnificent and mysterious community filled with playful personalities lives. Witness the exhilarating action, heartwarming encounters, and a closeup look at a stunning jungle teeming with wildlife as the inquisitive adolescent orangutan Indah prepares to leave her family and venture out on her own for the first time.

movies.title: Ordinary People
movies.summary: Beth, Calvin, and their son Conrad are living in the aftermath of the death of the other son. Conrad is overcome by grief and misplaced guilt to the extent of a suicide attempt. He is in therapy. Beth had always preferred his brother and is having difficulty being supportive to Conrad. Calvin is trapped between the two trying to hold the family together.
movies.tagline: Everything is in its proper place... except the past.

movies.title: Osiris
movies.summary: Special Forces commandos are abducted mid-operation by a mysterious spacecraft and, upon awakening, find themselves prey to a relentless alien race in a fight for survival.
movies.tagline: Earth’s deadliest soldiers just became the galaxy’s last hope.

movies.title: The Other Boleyn Girl
movies.summary: A sumptuous and sensual tale of intrigue, romance and betrayal set against the backdrop of a defining moment in European history: two beautiful sisters, Anne (Natalie Portman) and Mary Boleyn (Scarlett Johansson), driven by their family's blind ambition, compete for the love of the handsome and passionate King Henry VIII (Eric Bana).
movies.tagline: Two sisters divided for the love of a king.

movies.title: Outcast
movies.summary: A mysterious warrior teams up with the daughter and son of a deposed Chinese Emperor to defeat their cruel brother, who seeks their deaths.
movies.tagline: To save their souls they must save a kingdom.

movies.title: Outcome
movies.summary: Reef Hawk, Hollywood's poster child since age six, is not okay. When he learns about an extortion plot tied to a mysterious video, Reef preemptively sets out on a redemption tour to make amends, confront his demons, and avoid getting canceled.

movies.title: Outlander
movies.summary: During the reign of the Vikings, Kainan, a man from a far-off world, crash lands on Earth, bringing with him an alien predator known as the Moorwen. Though both man and monster are seeking revenge for violence committed against them, Kainan leads the alliance to kill the Moorwen by fusing his advanced technology with the Viking's Iron Age weaponry.
movies.tagline: It destroyed his world. He won't let it destroy ours.

movies.title: Over Your Dead Body
movies.summary: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.
movies.tagline: Breakups are all in the execution.

movies.title: Oz the Great and Powerful
movies.summary: Oscar Diggs, a small-time circus illusionist and con-artist, is whisked from Kansas to the Land of Oz where the inhabitants assume he's the great wizard of prophecy, there to save Oz from the clutches of evil.
movies.tagline: In Oz, nothing is what it seems.

movies.title: Ozzy Osbourne: No Escape from Now
movies.summary: Ozzy Osbourne faces his identity and mortality after his world stops. Dealing with health issues and Parkinson's, he questions if he can perform again while music remains his life's cornerstone.
movies.tagline: An intimate look at Ozzy's final act.

movies.title: P S I Love You 2007 M1080p DD 5 1
Pain & Gain
movies.summary: Daniel Lugo, manager of the Sun Gym in 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul and Adrian as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.
movies.tagline: Their American dream is bigger than yours.

movies.title: Panda Plan
movies.summary: Soon after legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan is invited to adopt a beloved zoo panda named Hu Hu, a notorious international crime syndicate sets its sights on the bear and offers a massive bounty for his capture. Faced with this sudden crisis, Jackie enlists the help of his agent and Hu Hu's fiercely dedicated caretaker, leading the trio on an outrageous and unforgettable adventure as they seek to outsmart-and outkick-the bad guys at every turn.

movies.title: Pangolin: Kulu's Journey
movies.summary: A man discovers purpose helping rescue a trafficked baby pangolin in South Africa. He dedicates himself to rehabilitating the endangered animal for release into the wild, in this film from My Octopus Teacher's director.

movies.title: Parker
movies.summary: A thief with a unique code of professional ethics is double-crossed by his crew and left for dead. Assuming a new disguise and forming an unlikely alliance with a woman on the inside, he looks to hijack the score of the crew's latest heist.
movies.tagline: To get away clean, you have to play dirty.

movies.title: Patton
movies.summary: "Patton" tells the tale of General George S. Patton, famous tank commander of World War II. The film begins with Patton's career in North Africa and progresses through the invasion of Germany and the fall of the Third Reich. Side plots also speak of Patton's numerous faults such his temper and habit towards insubordination.
movies.tagline: The Rebel Warrior

movies.title: The Peacemaker
movies.summary: When a train carrying atomic warheads mysteriously crashes in the former Soviet Union, a nuclear specialist discovers the accident is really part of a plot to cover up the theft of the weapons. Assigned to help her recover the missing bombs is a crack Special Forces Colonel.
movies.tagline: In the fall of 1997, every nuclear device in the world will be accounted for...except one.

movies.title: Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man
movies.summary: During World War II, Tommy Shelby returns to a bombed Birmingham and becomes involved in secret wartime missions facing new threats as he reckons with his past.
movies.tagline: It will all come to this.

movies.title: The Penguin Lessons
movies.summary: A disillusioned Englishman who goes to work in a school in a divided Argentina in 1976 finds his life transformed when he rescues an orphaned penguin from the beach.
movies.tagline: In 1976 Argentina, on the eve of a political revolution, a teacher and his students at an exclusive boys school are enlightened by an unusual guest.

movies.title: Penguins
movies.summary: The story of Steve, an Adélie penguin, on a quest to find a life partner and start a family. When Steve meets with Wuzzo the emperor penguin they become friends. But nothing comes easy in the icy Antarctic.
movies.tagline: For Steve, his adventure isn't all black and white.

movies.title: People Like Us
movies.summary: While settling his recently deceased father's estate, a salesman discovers he has a sister whom he never knew about, leading both siblings to re-examine their perceptions about family and life choices.
movies.tagline: Find your family.

movies.title: People We Meet on Vacation
movies.summary: Poppy wants to explore the world and Alex prefers to stay home with a good book, but somehow they are the very best of friends. They live far apart, but for a decade they have spent one week of summer vacation together.
movies.tagline: On vacation, you're free to follow your heart.

movies.title: Peppermint
movies.summary: Five years after her husband and daughter are killed in a senseless act of violence, a woman comes back from self-imposed exile to seek revenge against those responsible and the system that let them go free.
movies.tagline: The system failed. She won't.

movies.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
movies.summary: In order to restore their dying safe haven, the son of Poseidon and his friends embark on a quest to the Sea of Monsters, to find the mythical Golden Fleece, all the while trying to stop an ancient evil from rising.
movies.tagline: Where There Are Gods, There Are Monsters.

movies.title: A Perfect Getaway
movies.summary: Two pairs of lovers on a Hawaiian vacation discover that psychopaths are stalking and murdering tourists on the islands.
movies.tagline: Welcome to paradise. Enter at your own risk.

movies.title: The Perfect Man
movies.summary: Holly is tired of moving every time her mom Jean breaks up with yet another second-rate guy. To distract her mother from her latest bad choice, Holly conceives the perfect plan for the perfect man, an imaginary secret admirer who will romance Jean and boost her self-esteem.
movies.tagline: Is it all too good to be true?

movies.title: Personal Effects
movies.summary: A 24 y.o. wrestler/McJobroni man meets a mom 20+ years older at group therapy for family of murder victims (sister and husband). He helps her deaf teenage son. She invites him to weddings. They await convictions on the murder trials.
movies.tagline: The space between loss and love.

movies.title: Peter Pan & Wendy
movies.summary: Follow the adventures of Peter Pan, a boy who does not want to grow up, and how he recruits three siblings in London, and together they embark on a magical adventure on the enchanted island of Neverland.
movies.tagline: Escape to Neverland.

movies.title: The Pink Panther 2
movies.summary: Insp. Jacques Clouseau teams up with a squad of International detectives who are just as bumbling as he is. Their mission: Stop a globe-trotting thief who specializes in stealing historical artifacts.
movies.tagline: Inspect the unexpected.

movies.title: The Pixar Story
movies.summary: The Pixar Story takes audiences behind the scenes of the groundbreaking company that pioneered a new generation of animation and forever changed the face of filmmaking.
movies.tagline: Documentary about the history of Pixar animation

movies.title: The Place Beyond the Pines
movies.summary: A European-American stunt rider turns into a robber in order to lead a happy life with his child and lover, grabs the attention of a police officer. They both get on a collision course that affects their families.
movies.tagline: One moment can change your life.

movies.title: Play Dirty
movies.summary: An expert thief rolls out the biggest heist of his life in Play Dirty, an action-packed thriller from director Shane Black. Parker (Mark Wahlberg), along with Grofield (LaKeith Stanfield), Zen (Rosa Salazar) and a skilled crew, stumble onto a score that pits them against the New York mob in this gritty, clever caper.
movies.tagline: Even robbers get robbed.

movies.title: Playdate
movies.summary: When out-of-work accountant Brian joins stay-at-home dad Jeff for a playdate with their sons, he expects a laid-back afternoon. Instead, they're chased by mercenaries, and Brian—totally unprepared—must survive one absurd obstacle after another.
movies.tagline: Playtime just got real.

movies.title: Playing It Cool
movies.summary: Unrequited love motivates a guy to write about his experiences.
movies.tagline: Love... it's a balancing act

movies.title: Pleasantville
movies.summary: Geeky teenager David and his popular twin sister, Jennifer, get sucked into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom called "Pleasantville," and find a world where everything is peachy keen all the time. But when Jennifer's modern attitude disrupts Pleasantville's peaceful but boring routine, she literally brings color into its life.
movies.tagline: Nothing is as simple as black and white.

movies.title: Pompeii
movies.summary: A slave-turned-gladiator finds himself in a race against time to save his true love, who has been betrothed to a corrupt Roman Senator. As Mount Vesuvius erupts, he must fight to save his beloved as Pompeii crumbles around him.
movies.tagline: No warning. No escape.

movies.title: Practical Magic
movies.summary: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.
movies.tagline: For two sisters from a family of witches, falling in love is the trickiest spell of all.

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.summary: A multi-generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.
movies.tagline: Everything you've witched for.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.summary: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice--launch the most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.
movies.tagline: In the hours before D-Day, one decision changed the world.

movies.title: Pride & Prejudice
movies.summary: When Elizabeth Bennet meets the handsome Mr. Darcy, she believes he is the last man she could ever marry, but as their lives become intertwined, she finds herself captivated by the man she has sworn to hate forever.
movies.tagline: Sometimes the last person on earth you want to be with is the one person you can't be without.

movies.title: Primal Fear
movies.summary: When a young man, Aaron, is charged with the horrific murder of Archbishop Rushman, hot-shot Chicago lawyer Martin Vail takes on his defense at no charge. Aaron was a homeless street kid before he was taken in by the Archbishop. He's shy and speaks with a stammer. Vail is convinced that Aaron is innocent but after discovering a video that shows Aaron may have had good reason to want the Archbishop dead, he begins to question that conclusion.
movies.tagline: Sooner or later, a man who wears two faces forgets which one is real.

movies.title: Primate
movies.summary: College student Lucy and her friends spend their vacation at her family's home in Hawaii, which includes her pet chimpanzee, Ben. However, when Ben contracts rabies after being bitten by a rabid animal, the group must fight for their lives in order to avoid the now-violent chimp.
movies.tagline: Something's wrong with Ben.

movies.title: Primitive War
movies.summary: During the Vietnam War, a recon unit ventures to an isolated jungle valley to uncover the fate of a missing platoon. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives against an unexpected enemy — prehistoric dinosaurs.
movies.tagline: This ain't no walk in the park.

movies.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time
movies.summary: Set in the mystical lands of Persia, a rogue prince and a mysterious princess race against dark forces to safeguard an ancient dagger capable of releasing the Sands of Time -- a gift from the gods that can reverse time and allow its possessor to rule the world.
movies.tagline: Defy the future.

movies.title: The Princess Diaries 2: Royal Engagement
movies.summary: Mia Thermopolis is now a college graduate and on her way to Genovia to take up her duties as princess. Accompanied by her friend Lilly, Mia continues her 'princess lessons', like riding horses side-saddle and archery. But her already complicated life is turned upside down once again when she learns that she is to take the crown as queen earlier than expected, all while she meets a mysteriously charming young man.
movies.tagline: It can take a lifetime to find true love; she's got 30 days!

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.summary: After his six-year-old daughter is abducted, a desperate father takes justice into his own hands when he loses faith in the detective leading the investigation, setting both men on a collision course as the search descends into obsession and moral compromise.
movies.tagline: How far would you go to protect your child?

movies.title: Proof of Life
movies.summary: When Peter Bowman, an American engineer working in a South American country, is captured by anti-government forces, the rebels learn his identity and demand $5 million for his safe return. However, his US employer is on the verge of insolvency and will not provide the ransom. Peter's wife Alice is forced to deal with the matter on her own and she retains the services of freelance professional hostage negotiator Terry Thorne.
movies.tagline: For her, it's personal. For him, it's a contract.

movies.title: Punch-Drunk Love
movies.summary: An entrepreneur with social anxiety falls victim to a blackmailing scheme that jeopardizes his chance at true love.
movies.tagline: I have a love in my life. It makes me stronger than anything you can imagine.

movies.title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
movies.summary: Frank is haunted by hallucinations of his dead squad mates and family. A vengeful mother seeking revenge against Frank for his killing her husband and sons puts out a bounty on his head that brings dozens of criminals out, all trying to kill Frank.
movies.tagline: Hey Frank.

movies.title: R.I.P.D.
movies.summary: In the afterlife, Nick Walker, a detective who used to work for the Boston Police Department, is hired by a director of a group of deceased police officers to fight against the renegade ghosts.
movies.tagline: To protect and serve the living.

movies.title: The Rainmaker
movies.summary: Fresh out of law school and desperate for work, idealistic rookie Rudy Baylor takes on a powerful insurance company accused of denying a dying boy’s claim. Teaming up with a scrappy, unlicensed paralegal, he finds himself in a David-versus-Goliath courtroom battle that tests his ethics, courage, and belief in justice.
movies.tagline: They were totally unqualified to try the case of a lifetime... but every underdog has his day.

movies.title: The Rats: A Witcher Tale
movies.summary: Follows a group of thieves as they plan the biggest heist of their lives against the most dangerous crime ring in the kingdom.

movies.title: The Reader
movies.summary: The story of Michael Berg, a German lawyer who, as a teenager in the late 1950s, had an affair with an older woman, Hanna, who then disappeared only to resurface years later as one of the defendants in a war crimes trial stemming from her actions as a concentration camp guard late in the war. He alone realizes that Hanna is illiterate and may be concealing that fact at the expense of her freedom.
movies.tagline: Behind the mystery lies a truth that will make you question everything you know.

movies.title: Ready or Not
movies.summary: A bride's wedding night takes a sinister turn when her eccentric new in-laws force her to take part in a terrifying game.
movies.tagline: A killer game of hide and seek.

movies.title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
movies.summary: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.
movies.tagline: Double or nothing.

movies.title: Ready Player One
movies.summary: When the creator of a virtual reality called the OASIS dies, he makes a posthumous challenge to all OASIS users to find his Easter Egg, which will give the finder his fortune and control of his world.
movies.tagline: A better reality awaits.

movies.title: Real Steel
movies.summary: Charlie Kenton is a washed-up fighter who retired from the ring when robots took over the sport. After his robot is trashed, he reluctantly teams up with his estranged son to rebuild and train an unlikely contender.
movies.tagline: Courage is stronger than steel.

movies.title: RED 2
movies.summary: Retired CIA agent Frank Moses reunites his unlikely team of elite operatives for a global quest to track down a missing portable nuclear device.
movies.tagline: The best never rest.

movies.title: Red Corner
movies.summary: An American attorney on business in China is wrongfully arrested and put on trial for murder, with a female defense lawyer from the country the only key to proving his innocence.
movies.tagline: Severity for those who resist.

movies.title: Red Planet
movies.summary: Astronauts, and their robotic dog AMEE (Autonomous Mapping Evaluation and Evasion), search for solutions to save a dying Earth by searching on Mars, only to have the mission go terribly awry.
movies.tagline: Not a sound. Not a warning. Not a chance. Not alone.

movies.title: Red Riding Hood
movies.summary: A woman and everyone in the villiage she lives in are suspects to a series of killings by a werewolf.
movies.tagline: Who's afraid?

movies.title: Red Sonja
movies.summary: Captured and forced to fight for survival, Red Sonja must rally an army of outcasts to reclaim her freedom and take down a tyrant and his ruthless bride.
movies.tagline: A hero will rise... An empire will fall.

movies.title: Reign of Fire
movies.summary: In post-apocalyptic England, an American volunteer and a British survivor team up to fight off a brood of fire-breathing dragons seeking to return to global dominance after centuries of rest underground. The Brit—leading a clan of survivors to hunt down the King of the Dragons—has much at stake: his mother was killed by a dragon, but his love is still alive.
movies.tagline: They're extremely intelligent. Highly evolved. And they don't like sharing the planet.

movies.title: Reindeer Games
movies.summary: An ex-con is forced into a casino heist.
movies.tagline: The trap is set. The game is on.

movies.title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
movies.summary: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.
movies.tagline: Brighter together.

movies.title: Reminiscence
movies.summary: Nick Bannister, a private investigator of the mind, navigates the alluring world of the past when his life is changed by new client Mae. A simple case becomes an obsession after she disappears and he fights to learn the truth about her.
movies.tagline: Don't look back.

movies.title: Replicas
movies.summary: A daring synthetic biologist, after a car accident kills his family, will stop at nothing to bring them back, even if it means pitting himself against a government-controlled laboratory, a police task force and the physical laws of science.
movies.tagline: Some humans are unstoppable

movies.title: Reptile
movies.summary: A real estate agent's murder pulls Detective Tom Nichols into a widening investigation where suspicious partners, buried grudges, and unsettling evidence expose deeper dangers beneath a seemingly peaceful suburban community.
movies.tagline: Shed the lies.

movies.title: Resident Evil: Death Island
movies.summary: A t-virus outbreak in San Francisco leads to Alcatraz Island, where a new evil has taken residence.
movies.tagline: Destinies intertwined. A world gone mad.

movies.title: The Rewrite
movies.summary: Keith Michaels, an academy award winner for his screenplay for the movie "Paradise Misplaced", now faces the challenge of being rejected in Hollywood. To get a breakthrough he is forced to take the job he most hates, teaching. The assignment is at a college is far from his comforts and could possibly take him to a new life.
movies.tagline: A comedy about getting on the same page.

movies.title: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
movies.summary: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.
movies.tagline: We’re all gonna die. May as well have a laugh about it.

movies.title: Riddick
movies.summary: Left for dead on a sun-scorched planet, Riddick finds himself up against an alien race of predators. Activating an emergency beacon alerts two ships: one carrying a new breed of mercenary, the other captained by a man from Riddick's past.
movies.tagline: Survival Is His Revenge

movies.title: The Rip
movies.summary: A group of Miami cops discovers a stash of millions in cash, leading to distrust as outsiders learn about the huge seizure, making them question who to rely on.
movies.tagline: Count the money. Count it again. Count on no one.

movies.title: Risque
movies.summary: A group of strippers seek revenge on their bosses by robbing the strip clubs in which they work.
movies.tagline: Kishi kaisei!

movies.title: A River Runs Through It
movies.summary: In the 1920s, the Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.
movies.tagline: Nothing perfect lasts forever. Except in our memories.

movies.title: The Roast of Kevin Hart
movies.summary: Live roast of Kevin Hart taking place at The Kia Forum in Los Angeles as part of Netflix Is a Joke Fest 2026.

movies.title: Robin Hood
movies.summary: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of world power.
movies.tagline: Rise and rise again, until lambs become lions

movies.title: Roofman
movies.summary: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.
movies.tagline: Based on actual events. And terrible decisions.

movies.title: Roommates
movies.summary: When a hopeful, naive college freshman, Devon, asks the cool and confident Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship spirals into a war of passive aggression.
movies.tagline: One dorm. Zero boundaries.

movies.title: The Roses
movies.summary: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Ivy (Colman) and Theo (Cumberbatch): successful careers, great kids, an enviable sex life. But underneath the façade of the perfect family is a tinderbox of competition and resentments that's ignited when Theo's professional dreams come crashing down.
movies.tagline: This marriage ain't big enough for the both of them.

movies.title: Runaway Jury
movies.summary: Wendell Rohr is a torts lawyer taking on the gun lobby. Rankin Fitch is the jury consultant for the Defendants and between them the battle is for the hearts and minds of the jury. But there is someone on the inside. Nicholas Easter is a juror with a girlfriend, Marlee, on the outside. they have a past ..... and their own agenda.
movies.tagline: Trials are too important to be decided by juries.

movies.title: The Rundown
movies.summary: When Travis, the mouthy son of a criminal, disappears in the Amazon in search of a treasured artifact, his father sends in Beck, who becomes Travis's rival for the affections of Mariana, a mysterious Brazilian woman. With his steely disposition, Beck is a man of few words -- but it takes him all the discipline he can muster to work with Travis to nab a tyrant who's after the same treasure.
movies.tagline: Bulls, guns, whips, gold and one sacred cat.

movies.title: The Runner
movies.summary: A successful London-based attorney (GAL GADOT) is thrust into a tense and dangerous race across the city after her son, Noah (RORY WILMOT) is abducted. Forced to obey a series of cryptic commands from a mysterious Caller (DAMIAN LEWIS), she races against time through a web of secrets and threats in a desperate bid to save her son.
movies.tagline: One hour. One chance to save her son.

movies.title: Rush
movies.summary: James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.
movies.tagline: Everyone's driven by something.

movies.title: The Russia House
movies.summary: Bartholomew "Barley" Scott Blair, a British publisher torn between moral conviction and self-preservation, is drawn into MI5 and CIA surveillance as he pursues a mysterious Russian contact tied to nuclear manuscript intelligence stakes.
movies.tagline: Their love was as dangerous as the secrets they kept.

movies.title: Sabrina
movies.summary: After her return from school in Paris, a playboy finally takes notice of his family's chauffeur's daughter, who's long had a crush on him, but he questions his more serious brother's motives when he warns against getting involved with her.
movies.tagline: ...the chauffeur's daughter who learned her stuff in Paris.

movies.title: Salt
movies.summary: A CIA agent goes on the run after a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy.
movies.tagline: Who is Salt?

movies.title: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
movies.summary: After losing both parents, Sarah Silverman turns grief into comedy, finding humor in funeral planning and final moments with her mother while maintaining her characteristic wit.

movies.title: Saving Mr. Banks
movies.summary: P. L. Travers, a London author who is financially broke, visits Los Angeles to meet Walt Disney, who is keen to adapt her Mary Poppins books for the cinema. However, his methods do not meet her approval.
movies.tagline: Where her book ended, their story began.

movies.title: Scarface
